purpose: S13 adds the leave half of the membership module (D9): pure leave eligibility with the twin-read discipline on the library roster accessors (opposite fail-closed directions on the execution and the live-member path), the background leave (immediate UI removal, bounded soft-failing kind-9 announcement, group.leave() through the GroupOpQueue with skipSync, failure restore + leave-failed toast, no durable leaving marker), the single idempotent local purge (library abandon + sink purge + every app-side store, overlay row last as the retry key), and the library-driven membership changes (groupRemoved -> enqueued purge, startup check of listed groups whose members() lack the own account, disband notification/marker -> overlay marked disbanded).

public_api.name: decideLeave
public_api.description: leaveEligibility.ts. EXECUTION-path truth table: unreadable members -> {leave, rosterKnown:false} (fail-open, purge never skipped); sole member or account absent from a readable roster -> abandon; sole admin with other members -> blocked 'last-admin'; else leave. Case-insensitive.

public_api.name: selectLeaveModalState / readLiveMembers / readRosterFacts
public_api.description: leaveEligibility.ts. LIVE-MEMBER path, fail-closed in the OPPOSITE direction: an unreadable member list is undefined and never offered as abandon. readRosterFacts guards members() and activeAdmins() each on its own.

public_api.name: createGroupLeaver
public_api.description: leaveGroup.ts. decide -> hideGroup at once -> background: kind-9 leave_intent announcement (bounded announceTimeoutMs 5 s, soft-fail) -> queue.runCommit(group, () => group.leave(), {skipSync:true, signal}) bounded by leaveDeadlineMs 20 s -> purgeLocalGroup -> pendingView.scheduleRefresh(). Failure other than last-admin: restoreGroup + notifyLeaveFailed (i18n groups.leaveFailed); last-admin rejection: restoreGroup + notifyLastAdminBlocked; unreadable roster: purge never skipped, no restore. Same-group calls share one run. Every port validated at construction.

public_api.name: createLocalGroupPurger (seam GroupDataPurger)
public_api.description: purgeLocalGroup.ts. tracker.forgetGroup -> getGroup + group.abandon() (a failure aborts before any app-side deletion) -> history.purge -> re-join guard -> messages (+ edit aux/slot meta), reaction rows, held reactions, polls/votes, media, member profiles, profile-request memos, unread, join requests, invite links/expiries, pending-direct-invite markers (+ orphans) -> overlay row LAST and only when nothing failed (retry key for AC-WIPE-2) -> onPurged. Idempotent; concurrent calls share one run; PurgeError names the failed steps.

public_api.name: createGroupRemovalHandlers
public_api.signature: (deps: {ownPubkey, purger, enqueue, onError?}) => { onGroupRemoved(payload): void; checkListedGroups(groups): Promise<string[]> }
public_api.description: groupNotifications.ts. onGroupRemoved is a client-listener frame: only enqueues the purge as its last action (collapsing per group). checkListedGroups (startup, after groups.list(), under the lease): purges listed groups whose READABLE members() lack the own account; an unreadable roster is left alone (fail-closed); the group id is read before the purge (an abandoned handle throws from id).

public_api.name: createDisbandMarker
public_api.signature: (deps: {overlay:{load,save}, now, onMarked, onError?}) => { markDisbanded(groupId, info?): Promise<boolean>; disbandTarget(groupId): void; syncListed(groups): Promise<string[]> }
public_api.description: groupNotifications.ts. Marks the overlay row disbanded {actor?, at} (idempotent, per-group serialised, no row -> nothing). disbandTarget is the handlers router's disband target; syncListed re-marks at startup every listed group carrying the library's persisted group.disbanded marker (the notification is announced once).

public_api.name: clearReactionsForGroup (reactions/api.ts, scope amendment)
public_api.description: Deletes few:reactions:group:<id> on the thread's own write queue and cross-tab lock, cache emptied first, idempotent. Required by the S5 ledger obligation (purge reaction rows); no per-group delete existed.

owned_data: none exclusively: the purge deletes a group's rows from the stores their modules own (chat, reactions, polls, media, profiles, invite links, join requests, markers, unread) through injected ports; the overlay row's disbanded mark is written through an injected overlay port
dependencies_allowed: injected ports only: client.groups.get handle, GroupOpQueue (send/ runCommit shape), history sink purge, own-row tracker forgetGroup, the per-store clear functions, the S9 pending view scheduleRefresh, handle.enqueue
tests only: client/ (bootstrapAccountClient, createJobQueue), send/, invitations/ (inviter), handlers/ (router, realApp fixture), parseStructured
dependencies_forbidden: react or any src/context import under app/src/lib/marmot/** (AC-BOUND-1)
any account-scope client call from a library frame (groupRemoved listener / notification router): follow-ups only via handle.enqueue, enqueue last
publishing profile data or any group data outside the group (privacy invariant): the only send is the kind-9 leave_intent announcement into the group being left
external_ports: client.groups.get / group.leave() / group.abandon() via injected ports (production wiring: S18)
sendGroupRumor (SendGroupRumor seam) for the kind-9 announcement
events_consumed: client event groupRemoved {groupId, actor?} (at most once; lost on a crash between settle and emit: backed by checkListedGroups)
group notification group-disbanded (routed by the handlers module's createGroupNotificationRouter disband target) and the persisted MarmotGroup.disbanded marker
